messages:
Anjali (PM): Quick sync on the multi-turn reranker PRD I dropped into drive. Asking for a 20-min spec pass here: API contract options, acceptance criteria (quality/cost/latency), edge cases, rollout strategy.

Diego (ML): Read it. Core idea makes sense: generate k candidates, compute embeddings, score candidates with learned scorer + embed similarity, return re-ordered completions. Proposed success metric: relative NDCG@5 >= 0.08 on prod-like eval; also keep MRR uplift and check calibration.

Maya (SWE): API design question: add new endpoint /v1/rerank or extend chat/completions with `rerank_mode`? I prefer extending chat/completions to reduce surface area: body param `rerank_mode: "off|server|client"` where server = compute embeddings + score, client = accept candidate_embeddings from caller.

Liam (SRE): Important: rerank multiplies compute and can increase GPU memory for embedding model. Need per-org quotas and a cost-mitigation param: `max_candidates` (default 5). Also require a `timeout_ms` (hard cap) and documented fallback to original candidate order.

Nora (Design): From UX POV streaming matters. If we block streaming until rerank completes, chat agents will pause. Suggest default for hosted = non-blocking streaming: stream best-so-far and then emit final reorder event. For higher-tier/opt-in, support buffered response. Docs must show both flows.

Diego (ML): Implementation note: we can support two scoring modes: (A) heuristic embedding-similarity only (cheap), (B) learned scorer that ingests candidate text + context + embeddings (better quality, higher cost). Expose `scorer: "embed|learned"`. Acceptance criteria should be split by scorer.

Anjali (PM): Draft acceptance criteria: 1) Quality: scorer=learned yields NDCG@5 delta >= +0.09 vs baseline; scorer=embed delta >= +0.04. 2) Cost: median token-cost change <= +25% for embed scorer, <= +60% for learned (but justify in product doc). 3) Latency: p95 end-to-end delta <= +200ms for non-buffered small-chat flows; buffered path allowed slower. 4) Backcompat: default `rerank_mode` = off. 5) Safety: detect and surface if rerank reverses answer ordering unexpectedly (safety signal).

Maya (SWE): Example payload I put in the doc: 

```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "gptx-1",
  "messages": [...],
  "rerank_mode": "server",
  "rerank": {
    "scorer": "learned",
    "max_candidates": 6,
    "timeout_ms": 180
  }
}
```

Liam (SRE): Edge cases to enumerate: candidate generation timeout, candidate duplication, missing candidate text/embeddings, scorer crash, embedding model mismatch across infra (quantized vs fp16) -> add cross-variant calibration tests. And operationally, if an org exceeds cost threshold auto-disable rerank and notify.

Diego (ML): Add testbeds: curated eval sets + adversarial set with near-duplicate candidates; checks for label leakage (scorer overfits to dataset). Also ensure scorer determinism: tie-breaker = hash(candidate_text + candidate_index).

eng-bot: deploy-checker: canary feature flag created for feature `rerank_v1` (docs: /flags/rerank_v1).

Anjali (PM): Rollout plan suggestion: lab experiments -> internal canary (redwood-dev) -> 10% customer canary on paid orgs -> 50% after SLA checks -> GA opt-in for all paid -> default off for free. Add telemetry: per-request cost multiplier, delta NDCG, p95 latency, error fraction.

Maya (SWE): Implementation action items: - finalize API schema (support client-provided embeddings + server embed fallback) - implement scorer interface + sandbox model - streaming semantics doc + example SDK behavior - tests for timeouts and fallback.

Diego (ML): I'll own the eval harness and the learned scorer prototype. Need product to provide promotion prompts + retrieval examples. Will produce NDCG/MRR/CAPEX sim reports.

Liam (SRE): I'll add infra tasks: per-tenant quotas, circuit-breaker logic, metrics dashboards, and runbook for auto-disable. Also will add load test to simulate 5x request fanout from rerank.

Nora (Design): I'll make example UX mocks for final-order event (non-blocking stream) and buffered mode. Also draft doc copy that explains cost/latency tradeoffs clearly.

Anjali (PM): Great. Owners: Diego = eval + scorer, Maya = API + SDK semantics, Liam = infra/runbook, Nora = docs/mocks. Timeline: prototype in 3 weeks, canary in 8 weeks. I'll update PRD and create RFC for API contract. Post any final notes here by EOD.

Diego (ML): thumbs-up. One more note: support `provided_embeddings: true` flag if clients send embeddings; must validate length/dim and reject mismatches with 400.

Maya (SWE): noted. Also propose `reorder_event` in response schema when buffered: `{ "type": "rerank.final", "order": [0,2,1,...] }` so clients can apply reordering on the fly.

Anjali (PM): Perfect. I'll consolidate and push updated PRD + RFC link in this thread. Thanks all.
